eval.title: ULTA Stock - Great Businesses Always Climb A Wall Of Worry!

call.headline_quote: I don't think it's a value investment margin of safety it's not cheap even if you would say send a p ratio of 15

base_metric.name: fcf_per_share
base_metric.quote: cash generation 1.5 billion minus the capex of the refurbishing and everything so 1 billion pure cash flow creation

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: 1 billion compared to the 18 billion market capitalization is a repurchase yield of a few percentage points let's round it up to 5%

what_is_priced_in.quote: the p ratio is 20 from the cash flow perspective and that is already not cheap 10 12 for a great businesses that's something that could be interesting

reasons.claim: A 5% cash yield on the market cap is not a margin-of-safety bargain, and if growth stops that yield could effectively double, implying a 50% price drop.
reasons.quote: 5% profit yield on the current market cap is not a margin of safety bargain because if they stop growing then it's just 5% that easily goes to 10% and then your stock drops 50%

reasons.claim: Comparable sales have slowed sharply, signaling the business may have plateaued and discretionary spending is under pressure, with a recession historically cutting the stock 80%.
reasons.quote: comparable sales increased just 1.6% thus there is something going on if these comparable sales don't grow then the business as it is now has reached is plateau

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.016, as-of 0.0978317 (FY2024); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Growing competition from Sephora (LVMH) threatens Ulta's long-term growth even though great businesses can climb a wall of worry for a while.
reasons.quote: the next worry now is Sephora from lvmh so they are are growing expanding in the United States expanding already being in Mexico so this selective retailing from Sephora is now the competition

reasons.claim: International expansion into Mexico and Latin America, where the business model could replicate US success, offers a growth avenue.
reasons.quote: Latin America they say it's similar to the United States so their business model could work there however you never know how that spending and the return on Capital will be there

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: The company continues to generate cash and repurchase shares despite the slowdown, underscoring underlying business quality.
reasons.quote: the company is still there still great still making a lot of money still repurchasing shares so cash generation 1.5 billion minus the capex

data_check.gap_note: he says 1.5e+09, as-of 7.66594e+08 (FY2024); annual vs TTM or a different definition

external_facts_used: Ulta's comparable sales growth of 1.6% last quarter
Sephora (LVMH) expansion into the US and Mexico as competitive threat
Ulta's planned expansion into Target stores and Mexico
